name: Mr. Guo's Love
overview: A father and daughter must overcome ten years of hurt after he returns home from living abroad for 10 years. The daughter has lived with an aunt for all that time after her parents' divorce and abandonment. Rebellious and refusing to reconcile with her father, the two go through a difficult time. Only the aunt's soothing love and care can calm the turbulent feelings of father and daughter and help them understand their roles in this family.
